items.q: What is Khloé's first lesson for women at 30 under marriage pressure?
items.a: **Comparison is the thief of joy.** You watch someone else's **highlight reel** while someone else watches yours. Want marriage/kids because **you** want them, not because you were taught to. Shetty: purify envy by **studying** the messy start, not envying the peak.

items.q: Why did she skip into 40 instead of dreading it?
items.a: The 30s were the hard decade (kids, bad relationships, career not matching the plan). At 40 the **deadline dropped**. Old Golden Girls fear vs JLo/Union **liveliness**. She feels **solid** and stopped requiring it to be done before 40.

After public cheating she would not go to the **grocery store** and meet someone's eyes. Many of those people had **never heard the story**. Social-media narration kept the cloud running longer than private pain would have.

items.q: What was harder than forgiving the people who hurt her?
items.a: **Forgiving herself.** She was fluent at giving others grace. The last **~3 years** were giving herself the same energy. Shetty: **I made a mistake vs I am a mistake.** You cannot rush leaving or you keep the **what-if**.

items.q: What is her faith reframe instead of waiting for a miracle ladder?
items.a: God can send the **recipe**. You still **bake the cake**. 20s coping was **party/drink/date** after dad at 19 and after divorce. Now: **5 a.m.** coffee, prayer, Bible app. Thank God in the **good times**, not only the ditch.

items.q: How did she first show up in therapy?
items.a: **Monotone biography.** Homework: write mini and major traumas, then go **line by line**. She laughed when asked if she felt anything. She would rather **not feel than feel**. She still **apologizes after crying**.

items.q: Why did she overgive, and what should a boundary actually protect?
items.a: Caretaking was how she **earned a seat** — chubby-compared, funny as the available praise. Shetty: a boundary should not limit the **ability to love**. It should protect you from loving the **wrong person**.

items.q: Why did she cut Lamar for ~10 years, then still call showing up strength?
items.a: After the overdose she paid for a house through rehab. He **used again**. She said she could never see him. Reunion via Malika: love, sadness at **outgrowing** him, **forgive and don't forget**. Hospital / Amari in the house were **strength**, not weakness — you sleep with what you did.
